import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a = list(map(int, input[1:]))
    ones = a.count(1)
    twos = a.count(2)
    teams = min(ones // 3, twos)
    ones -= teams * 3
    twos -= teams
    if ones >= 1 and twos >= 2:
        teams += 1
        ones -= 1
        twos -= 2
    print(teams)

main()
